name: 직접 코딩 (OpenAI SDK·curl)
description: 파이썬·자바스크립트 프로그램이나 LangChain에서 쓰는 예제 코드.

snippets.title: Python (openai)
snippets.text:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="{API_BASE}", api_key="{API_KEY_OR_DUMMY}")
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="{MODEL}",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "안녕!"}],
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)

snippets.title: JavaScript (openai)
LangChain (Python)
snippets.text:
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI

llm = ChatOpenAI(base_url="{API_BASE}", api_key="{API_KEY_OR_DUMMY}", model="{MODEL}")
print(llm.invoke("안녕!").content)
